```bash
python3 -c "
import zipfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
def read_docx(path):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
        xml_content = z.read('word/document.xml')
    root = ET.fromstring(xml_content)
    ns = {'w': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'}
    paragraphs = root.findall('.//w:p', ns)
    text = []
    for p in paragraphs:
        runs = p.findall('.//w:t', ns)
        line = ''.join(r.text for r in runs if r.text)
        if line.strip():
            text.append(line.strip())
    return '\n'.join(text)

print('=== CUMULATIVE DOC ===')
print(read_docx('doc/Maxxes_PreLab_Cumulative.docx'))
print()
print('=== MVP BUILD REQUIREMENTS ===')
print(read_docx('doc/Maxxes_MVP_Build_Requirements.docx'))
"
```

   227→## Risk Register

   232→| Database connection fails in production | Medium | Critical | Test deploy early (Day 1). Have fallback plan to revert to mock data if DB integration isn't stable by Thursday. |
   233→| Merge conflicts from 5 people editing simultaneously | High | Medium | Use feature branches. Luke owns all `+page.svelte` files. Ethan owns `database.ts` and `seed.ts`. Minimize overlap. |
   234→| Demo breaks during presentation | Medium | Critical | Record a backup video of the demo flow. Practice on the actual Vercel URL, not localhost. |
   235→| Not enough time to complete everything | Medium | High | Prioritize: deploy > data wiring > tests > polish. A deployed app with mock data is better than an undeployed app with a perfect backend. |

```text
     1→// Prisma schema for Maxxes - Based on existing types and PostgreSQL requirements
     2→generator client {
     3→  provider = "prisma-client-js"
     4→  output   = "../generated/prisma"
     5→}
     6→
     7→datasource db {
     8→  provider = "postgresql"
     9→  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
    10→}
    11→
    12→// User/Fan Profile
    13→model User {
    14→  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
    15→  fan_id          String   @unique // For compatibility with existing frontend
    16→  email           String?  @unique
    17→  name            String
    18→  avatar_initials String
    19→  city            String
    20→  member_since    DateTime @default(now())
    21→  created_at      DateTime @default(now())
    22→  updated_at      DateTime @updatedAt
    23→
    24→  // Fan profile data (flatten into User for simplicity)
    25→  xp_total        Int      @default(0)
    26→  current_tier    Tier     @default(BRONZE)
    27→  streak_days     Int      @default(0)
    28→  rank            Int?
    29→  percentile      Int?
    30→  top_artist      String?
    31→  top_venue       String?
    32→  events_attended Int      @default(0)
    33→  
    34→  // API integration fields
    35→  spotify_id      String?
    36→  apple_music_id  String?
    37→  discord_id      String?
    38→  lastfm_username String?
    39→  
    40→  // Relationships
    41→  event_interactions UserEvent[]
    42→  challenge_progress UserChallenge[]
    43→  xp_transactions    XpTransaction[]
    44→  friend_activities  FriendActivity[] @relation("UserFriendActivities")
    45→  recent_activities  RecentActivity[]
    46→  
    47→  @@map("users")
    48→}
    49→
    50→// Events
    51→model Event {
    52→  id              String        @id @default(cuid())
    53→  event_id        String        @unique // For frontend compatibility
    54→  title           String
    55→  subtitle        String?
    56→  artist          String?
    57→  venue           String
    58→  city            String
    59→  date            DateTime
    60→  category        EventCategory
    61→  image_url       String?
    62→  status          String?       // "upcoming", "live", "ended"
    63→  trending        Boolean       @default(false)
    64→  featured        Boolean       @default(false)
    65→  created_at      DateTime      @default(now())
    66→  
    67→  // Relationships
    68→  user_events     UserEvent[]
    69→  
    70→  @@map("events")
    71→}
    72→
    73→// User-Event interactions (bookmarks, attendance, etc.)
    74→model UserEvent {
    75→  id          String    @id @default(cuid())
    76→  user_id     String
    77→  event_id    String
    78→  bookmarked  Boolean   @default(false)
    79→  notify_me   Boolean   @default(false)
    80→  attended    Boolean   @default(false)
    81→  created_at  DateTime  @default(now())
    82→  
    83→  user        User      @relation(fields: [user_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
    84→  event       Event     @relation(fields: [event_id], references: [event_id], onDelete: Cascade)
    85→  
    86→  @@unique([user_id, event_id])
    87→  @@map("user_events")
    88→}
    89→
    90→// Challenges
    91→model Challenge {
    92→  id              String    @id @default(cuid())
    93→  challenge_id    String    @unique // For frontend compatibility
    94→  title           String
    95→  description     String?
    96→  category        String    // "Attendance", "Discovery", "Social", etc.
    97→  xp_reward       Int
    98→  difficulty      String    @default("Medium")
    99→  tasks           Json      // Array of task objects
   100→  progress_target Int       @default(100)
   101→  active          Boolean   @default(true)
   102→  created_at      DateTime  @default(now())
   103→  
   104→  user_challenges UserChallenge[]
   105→  
   106→  @@map("challenges")
   107→}
   108→
   109→// User Challenge Progress
   110→model UserChallenge {
   111→  id             String    @id @default(cuid())
   112→  user_id        String
   113→  challenge_id   String
   114→  completed      Boolean   @default(false)
   115→  progress       Int       @default(0) // Progress percentage (0-100)
   116→  tasks_completed Json     @default("[]") // Array of completed task IDs
   117→  completed_at   DateTime?
   118→  created_at     DateTime  @default(now())
   119→  
   120→  user           User      @relation(fields: [user_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
   121→  challenge      Challenge @relation(fields: [challenge_id], references: [challenge_id], onDelete: Cascade)
   122→  
   123→  @@unique([user_id, challenge_id])
   124→  @@map("user_challenges")
   125→}
   126→
   127→// XP Transaction Log
   128→model XpTransaction {
   129→  id          String    @id @default(cuid())
   130→  user_id     String
   131→  amount      Int
   132→  source      String    // "Event Attendance", "Venue Check-ins", "Challenges", etc.
   133→  reference   String?   // Event ID, Challenge ID, etc.
   134→  description String?
   135→  created_at  DateTime  @default(now())
   136→  
   137→  user        User      @relation(fields: [user_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
   138→  
   139→  @@map("xp_transactions")
   140→}
   141→
   142→// Passes (Access tier rewards)
   143→model Pass {
   144→  id          String     @id @default(cuid())
   145→  pass_id     String     @unique
   146→  user_id     String?
   147→  title       String
   148→  description String?
   149→  tier        Tier
   150→  status      PassStatus @default(AVAILABLE)
   151→  valid_until DateTime?
   152→  created_at  DateTime   @default(now())
   153→  claimed_at  DateTime?
   154→  
   155→  @@map("passes")
   156→}
   157→
   158→// Friend Activity (social feed)
   159→model FriendActivity {
   160→  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
   161→  user_id     String
   162→  friend_name String
   163→  activity    String
   164→  xp_change   Int?
   165→  created_at  DateTime @default(now())
   166→  
   167→  user        User     @relation("UserFriendActivities", fields: [user_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
   168→  
   169→  @@map("friend_activities")
   170→}
   171→
   172→// Recent Activity (user's own activity log)
   173→model RecentActivity {
   174→  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
   175→  user_id     String
   176→  activity    String
   177→  description String?
   178→  xp_earned   Int      @default(0)
   179→  created_at  DateTime @default(now())
   180→  
   181→  user        User     @relation(fields: [user_id], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
   182→  
   183→  @@map("recent_activities")
   184→}
   185→
   186→// Leaderboard (computed/cached view)
   187→model LeaderboardEntry {
   188→  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
   189→  user_id    String
   190→  name       String
   191→  xp_total   Int
   192→  tier       Tier
   193→  rank       Int
   194→  city       String?
   195→  period     Period   @default(ALL_TIME) // WEEKLY, MONTHLY, ALL_TIME
   196→  computed_at DateTime @default(now())
   197→  
   198→  @@unique([user_id, period])
   199→  @@index([period, rank])
   200→  @@map("leaderboard")
   201→}
   202→
   203→// Enums
   204→enum Tier {
   205→  BRONZE
   206→  SILVER
   207→  GOLD
   208→  PLATINUM
   209→  DIAMOND
   210→  
   211→  @@map("tier")
   212→}
   213→
   214→enum EventCategory {
   215→  MUSIC
   216→  SPORTS
   217→  THEATER
   218→  COMEDY
   219→  OTHER
   220→  
   221→  @@map("event_category")
   222→}
   223→
   224→enum PassStatus {
   225→  AVAILABLE
   226→  CLAIMED
   227→  ACTIVE
   228→  EXPIRED
   229→  
   230→  @@map("pass_status")
   231→}
   232→
   233→enum Period {
   234→  WEEKLY
   235→  MONTHLY
   236→  ALL_TIME
   237→  
   238→  @@map("period")
   239→}
```

```text
     1→// Database client and utilities for Maxxes
     2→import { PrismaClient } from '../../../generated/prisma/index.js';
     3→import { dev } from '$app/environment';
     4→
     5→// Singleton pattern for Prisma client
     6→const globalForPrisma = globalThis as unknown as {
     7→  prisma: PrismaClient | undefined;
     8→};
     9→
    10→export const db =
    11→  globalForPrisma.prisma ??
    12→  new PrismaClient({
    13→    log: dev ? ['query', 'error', 'warn'] : ['error'],
    14→  });
    15→
    16→if (dev) globalForPrisma.prisma = db;
    17→
    18→// Helper functions for common database operations
    19→
    20→export async function getUserByFanId(fanId: string) {
    21→  return await db.user.findUnique({
    22→    where: { fan_id: fanId },
    23→    include: {
    24→      event_interactions: {
    25→        include: { event: true }
    26→      },
    27→      challenge_progress: {
    28→        include: { challenge: true }
    29→      }
    30→    },
    31→  });
    32→}
    33→
    34→export async function getUserByEmail(email: string) {
    35→  return await db.user.findUnique({
    36→    where: { email },
    37→  });
    38→}
    39→
    40→export async function createUser(data: {
    41→  email?: string;
    42→  name: string;
    43→  city: string;
    44→  fan_id?: string;
    45→}) {
    46→  const fanId = data.fan_id || `fan_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
    47→  
    48→  return await db.user.create({
    49→    data: {
    50→      fan_id: fanId,
    51→      email: data.email,
    52→      name: data.name,
    53→      city: data.city,
    54→      avatar_initials: data.name.split(' ').map(n => n[0]).join('').toUpperCase(),
    55→      xp_total: 0,
    56→      current_tier: 'BRONZE',
    57→      streak_days: 0,
    58→      events_attended: 0,
    59→    },
    60→  });
    61→}
    62→
    63→export async function updateUserProfile(fanId: string, data: {
    64→  xp_total?: number;
    65→  current_tier?: string;
    66→  streak_days?: number;
    67→  events_attended?: number;
    68→  top_artist?: string;
    69→  top_venue?: string;
    70→  city?: string;
    71→}) {
    72→  return await db.user.update({
    73→    where: { fan_id: fanId },
    74→    data,
    75→  });
    76→}
    77→
    78→export async function getLeaderboard(period: 'WEEKLY' | 'MONTHLY' | 'ALL_TIME' = 'ALL_TIME', city?: string) {
    79→  const where: any = { period };
    80→  if (city) where.city = city;
    81→
    82→  return await db.leaderboardEntry.findMany({
    83→    where,
    84→    orderBy: { rank: 'asc' },
    85→    take: 100,
    86→  });
    87→}
    88→
    89→export async function getUserEvents(fanId: string) {
    90→  return await db.userEvent.findMany({
    91→    where: { 
    92→      user: { fan_id: fanId } 
    93→    },
    94→    include: {
    95→      event: true,
    96→    },
    97→    orderBy: {
    98→      event: { date: 'asc' },
    99→    },
   100→  });
   101→}
   102→
   103→export async function getUpcomingEvents(category?: string, city?: string, limit: number = 20) {
   104→  const where: any = {
   105→    date: { gte: new Date() },
   106→  };
   107→  
   108→  if (category && category !== 'all') {
   109→    where.category = category.toUpperCase();
   110→  }
   111→  
   112→  if (city) {
   113→    where.city = city;
   114→  }
   115→
   116→  return await db.event.findMany({
   117→    where,
   118→    orderBy: [
   119→      { featured: 'desc' },
   120→      { trending: 'desc' }, 
   121→      { date: 'asc' },
   122→    ],
   123→    take: limit,
   124→  });
   125→}
   126→
   127→export async function searchEvents(query: string, category?: string, limit: number = 20) {
   128→  const where: any = {
   129→    date: { gte: new Date() },
   130→    OR: [
   131→      { title: { contains: query, mode: 'insensitive' } },
   132→      { artist: { contains: query, mode: 'insensitive' } },
   133→      { venue: { contains: query, mode: 'insensitive' } },
   134→    ],
   135→  };
   136→  
   137→  if (category && category !== 'all') {
   138→    where.category = category.toUpperCase();
   139→  }
   140→
   141→  return await db.event.findMany({
   142→    where,
   143→    orderBy: { date: 'asc' },
   144→    take: limit,
   145→  });
   146→}
   147→
   148→export async function getUserChallenges(fanId: string, completed?: boolean) {
   149→  const where: any = { 
   150→    user: { fan_id: fanId } 
   151→  };
   152→  
   153→  if (typeof completed === 'boolean') {
   154→    where.completed = completed;
   155→  }
   156→
   157→  return await db.userChallenge.findMany({
   158→    where,
   159→    include: {
   160→      challenge: true,
   161→    },
   162→    orderBy: {
   163→      created_at: 'desc',
   164→    },
   165→  });
   166→}
   167→
   168→export async function addXpTransaction(fanId: string, data: {
   169→  amount: number;
   170→  source: string;
   171→  reference?: string;
   172→  description?: string;
   173→}) {
   174→  // Add XP transaction
   175→  const transaction = await db.xpTransaction.create({
   176→    data: {
   177→      user: { connect: { fan_id: fanId } },
   178→      amount: data.amount,
   179→      source: data.source,
   180→      reference: data.reference,
   181→      description: data.description,
   182→    },
   183→  });
   184→
   185→  // Update user's total XP
   186→  const user = await db.user.findUnique({
   187→    where: { fan_id: fanId },
   188→  });
   189→
   190→  if (user) {
   191→    const newTotal = user.xp_total + data.amount;
   192→    const newTier = calculateTier(newTotal);
   193→
   194→    await db.user.update({
   195→      where: { fan_id: fanId },
   196→      data: {
   197→        xp_total: newTotal,
   198→        current_tier: newTier,
   199→      },
   200→    });
   201→  }
   202→
   203→  return transaction;
   204→}
   205→
   206→export async function toggleEventBookmark(fanId: string, eventId: string) {
   207→  const existing = await db.userEvent.findUnique({
   208→    where: {
   209→      user_id_event_id: {
   210→        user_id: (await db.user.findUnique({ where: { fan_id: fanId } }))!.id,
   211→        event_id: eventId,
   212→      },
   213→    },
   214→  });
   215→
   216→  if (existing) {
   217→    return await db.userEvent.update({
   218→      where: { id: existing.id },
   219→      data: { bookmarked: !existing.bookmarked },
   220→    });
   221→  } else {
   222→    return await db.userEvent.create({
   223→      data: {
   224→        user: { connect: { fan_id: fanId } },
   225→        event: { connect: { event_id: eventId } },
   226→        bookmarked: true,
   227→      },
   228→    });
   229→  }
   230→}
   231→
   232→export async function updateChallengeProgress(fanId: string, challengeId: string, progress: number, completed: boolean = false) {
   233→  const existing = await db.userChallenge.findUnique({
   234→    where: {
   235→      user_id_challenge_id: {
   236→        user_id: (await db.user.findUnique({ where: { fan_id: fanId } }))!.id,
   237→        challenge_id: challengeId,
   238→      },
   239→    },
   240→  });
   241→
   242→  const data = {
   243→    progress,
   244→    completed,
   245→    completed_at: completed ? new Date() : null,
   246→  };
   247→
   248→  if (existing) {
   249→    return await db.userChallenge.update({
   250→      where: { id: existing.id },
   251→      data,
   252→    });
   253→  } else {
   254→    return await db.userChallenge.create({
   255→      data: {
   256→        user: { connect: { fan_id: fanId } },
   257→        challenge: { connect: { challenge_id: challengeId } },
   258→        ...data,
   259→      },
   260→    });
   261→  }
   262→}
   263→
   264→// Helper function to calculate tier based on XP
   265→function calculateTier(xp: number): 'BRONZE' | 'SILVER' | 'GOLD' | 'PLATINUM' | 'DIAMOND' {
   266→  if (xp >= 20000) return 'DIAMOND';
   267→  if (xp >= 10000) return 'PLATINUM';
   268→  if (xp >= 5000) return 'GOLD';
   269→  if (xp >= 2000) return 'SILVER';
   270→  return 'BRONZE';
   271→}
   272→
   273→// Cleanup function
   274→export async function disconnect() {
   275→  await db.$disconnect();
   276→}
```

```text
     1→import type { Tier } from './types.js';
     2→
     3→export const TIERS: Tier[] = [
     4→  { name: 'Bronze', xp_threshold: 0, perks: ['Basic access', 'Community membership'], color_hex: '#CD7F32' },
     5→  { name: 'Silver', xp_threshold: 2500, perks: ['Priority notifications', 'Early access'], color_hex: '#C0C0C0' },
     6→  { name: 'Gold', xp_threshold: 5000, perks: ['VIP seating', 'Meet & greets'], color_hex: '#FFD700' },
     7→  { name: 'Platinum', xp_threshold: 10000, perks: ['Backstage access', 'Exclusive events'], color_hex: '#E5E4E2' },
     8→  { name: 'Diamond', xp_threshold: 25000, perks: ['Ultimate access', 'Personal concierge'], color_hex: '#B9F2FF' }
     9→];
    10→
    11→export function classifyTier(xp: number): Tier {
    12→  // Find the highest tier the user qualifies for
    13→  const qualifiedTiers = TIERS.filter(tier => xp >= tier.xp_threshold);
    14→  return qualifiedTiers[qualifiedTiers.length - 1] || TIERS[0];
    15→}
    16→
    17→export function xpToNextTier(xp: number): number {
    18→  const currentTier = classifyTier(xp);
    19→  const currentTierIndex = TIERS.findIndex(tier => tier.name === currentTier.name);
    20→  
    21→  // If already at highest tier
    22→  if (currentTierIndex === TIERS.length - 1) {
    23→    return 0;
    24→  }
    25→  
    26→  const nextTier = TIERS[currentTierIndex + 1];
    27→  return nextTier.xp_threshold - xp;
    28→}
    29→
    30→export function tierProgress(xp: number): number {
    31→  const currentTier = classifyTier(xp);
    32→  const currentTierIndex = TIERS.findIndex(tier => tier.name === currentTier.name);
    33→  
    34→  // If at highest tier, progress is 100%
    35→  if (currentTierIndex === TIERS.length - 1) {
    36→    return 1.0;
    37→  }
    38→  
    39→  const nextTier = TIERS[currentTierIndex + 1];
    40→  const currentTierStart = currentTier.xp_threshold;
    41→  const nextTierStart = nextTier.xp_threshold;
    42→  
    43→  const progressInTier = xp - currentTierStart;
    44→  const tierRange = nextTierStart - currentTierStart;
    45→  
    46→  return Math.min(1.0, progressInTier / tierRange);
    47→}
    48→
    49→export function getTierByName(name: string): Tier | undefined {
    50→  return TIERS.find(tier => tier.name === name);
    51→}
    52→
    53→export function calculateRank(userXP: number, allScores: number[]): number {
    54→  const sortedScores = [...allScores].sort((a, b) => b - a);
    55→  const rank = sortedScores.findIndex(score => score <= userXP) + 1;
    56→  return rank || sortedScores.length + 1;
    57→}
    58→
    59→export function calculatePercentile(userXP: number, allScores: number[]): number {
    60→  const sortedScores = [...allScores].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    61→  const position = sortedScores.findIndex(score => score >= userXP);
    62→  
    63→  if (position === -1) {
    64→    return 100; // User has highest score
    65→  }
    66→  
    67→  return Math.round((position / sortedScores.length) * 100);
    68→}
```

```text
     1→import type { HotListArtist, HotListProgress, AppleMusicListeningHistory, Event } from './types.js';
     2→
     3→export function calculateArtistXP(artist: HotListArtist, playCount: number): number {
     4→  const baseXP = playCount * artist.xp_per_play * artist.xp_multiplier;
     5→
     6→  let bonusXP = 0;
     7→  for (const tier of artist.bonus_tiers) {
     8→    if (playCount >= tier.plays_required) {
     9→      bonusXP += tier.bonus_xp;
    10→    }
    11→  }
    12→
    13→  return Math.round(baseXP + bonusXP);
    14→}
    15→
    16→export function buildProgress(artist: HotListArtist, listeningHistory: AppleMusicListeningHistory[]): HotListProgress {
    17→  const historyEntry = listeningHistory.find(h => h.artist_id === artist.artist_id);
    18→  const playCount = historyEntry?.play_count ?? 0;
    19→  const xpEarned = calculateArtistXP(artist, playCount);
    20→
    21→  // Find current bonus tier (highest reached)
    22→  let currentBonusTier = 0;
    23→  for (let i = 0; i < artist.bonus_tiers.length; i++) {
    24→    if (playCount >= artist.bonus_tiers[i].plays_required) {
    25→      currentBonusTier = i + 1;
    26→    }
    27→  }
    28→
    29→  // Find next bonus threshold
    30→  const nextTier = artist.bonus_tiers.find(t => t.plays_required > playCount);
    31→  const nextBonusAt = nextTier?.plays_required ?? null;
    32→
    33→  return {
    34→    artist_id: artist.artist_id,
    35→    user_play_count: playCount,
    36→    xp_earned: xpEarned,
    37→    current_bonus_tier: currentBonusTier,
    38→    next_bonus_at: nextBonusAt
    39→  };
    40→}
    41→
    42→export function totalHotListXP(hotList: HotListArtist[], listeningHistory: AppleMusicListeningHistory[]): number {
    43→  return hotList.reduce((total, artist) => {
    44→    const progress = buildProgress(artist, listeningHistory);
    45→    return total + progress.xp_earned;
    46→  }, 0);
    47→}
    48→
    49→export function matchArtistsToEvents(
    50→  userArtistNames: string[],
    51→  events: Event[]
    52→): Map<string, { matched: boolean; matchedArtist?: string }> {
    53→  const matches = new Map<string, { matched: boolean; matchedArtist?: string }>();
    54→
    55→  for (const event of events) {
    56→    const titleLower = event.title.toLowerCase();
    57→    const matchedArtist = userArtistNames.find(name => titleLower.includes(name.toLowerCase()));
    58→
    59→    matches.set(event.event_id, {
    60→      matched: !!matchedArtist,
    61→      matchedArtist: matchedArtist
    62→    });
    63→  }
    64→
    65→  return matches;
    66→}
    67→
```

```text
   515→   515→Product Overview & MVP Definition
   516→   516→What Maxxes is and what the MVP must prove
   517→   517→Maxxes is a fan ranking, rewards, and community platform for the live events industry. It connects ticketing history and music streaming behavior into a single verified fan profile — the Superfan Score — and uses that score to unlock tier-based rewards, presale access, and community standing.
   518→   518→MVP Definition
   519→   519→The MVP is a functional, interactive, data-connected web application that can be demonstrated to investors, graded by instructors, and hosted publicly. It must prove five things: the aesthetic is production-quality, every screen is wireframed and built, interactions work, data flows live, and the app runs on a real URL.
   520→   520→What the MVP Is Not
   521→   521→A static slide deck or PDF mockup.
   522→   522→A prototype that requires a live presenter to explain every interaction.
   523→   523→An app that only works locally — it must be deployable to a public URL.
   524→   524→A full production platform — real Spotify and Ticketmaster API integrations are out of scope. Structured mock data simulates those signals.

   783→   783→05
   784→   784→Live Data Architecture — Passive Data Engagement
   785→   785→How the prototype connects to and displays real data without full API integration
   786→   786→Live data engagement means the prototype reads from a real data source at runtime — not hardcoded values. For the MVP, this means a structured JSON data layer hosted alongside the app (or on a lightweight backend) that the UI fetches on load. This is passive live data: the data can be updated by the team and the app will reflect those changes the next time a user loads it.
   787→   787→Live Data Strategy
   788→   788→The MVP uses seed JSON files as the data source. These files are real structured data — not embedded in the code. The app fetches them at runtime. This means the team can update fan scores, events, leaderboard positions, and challenges without touching the UI code. It also means the data layer is ready to be swapped for a real API when integrations are added.

   839→   839→XP Scoring — Client-Side Logic
   840→   840→The XP scoring calculation runs in the browser using data from fan-profile.json. This makes the score transparent, testable, and auditable during a demo.
   841→   841→// src/lib/domain/xp.ts
   842→   842→export const TIERS = [
   843→   843→{ name: 'Bronze',   min: 0,     max: 2499  },
   844→   844→{ name: 'Silver',   min: 2500,  max: 4999  },
   845→   845→{ name: 'Gold',     min: 5000,  max: 9999  },
   846→   846→{ name: 'Platinum', min: 10000, max: 24999 },
   847→   847→{ name: 'Diamond',  min: 25000, max: Infinity },
   848→   848→];
   849→   849→export function classifyTier(xp: number): string {
   850→   850→return TIERS.find(t => xp >= t.min && xp <= t.max)?.name ?? 'Bronze';
   851→   851→}
   852→   852→export function xpToNextTier(xp: number): number {
   853→   853→const next = TIERS.find(t => t.min > xp);
   854→   854→return next ? next.min - xp : 0;
   855→   855→}
   856→   856→export function tierProgress(xp: number): number {  // 0.0 – 1.0
   857→   857→const tier = TIERS.find(t => xp >= t.min && xp <= t.max);
   858→   858→if (!tier || tier.max === Infinity) return 1;
   859→   859→return (xp - tier.min) / (tier.max - tier.min);
   860→   860→}
```
